label: Control Weather (intensify or dispel storm only)

pieces.Text: You change the weather in the local area.

You change the weather in the local area. It takes 10 minutes to cast the spell and an additional 10 minutes for the effects to manifest. You can use this spell to cause storms in the area to become calm or increase in intensity. You cannot control specific applications of the weather-where lightning strikes, for example, or the exact path of a tornado. The weather continues as you left it for the duration, or until you use a standard action to designate a new kind of weather [which fully manifests itself 10 minutes later]. Contradictory conditions are not possible simultaneously.
2-mile-radius circle, centered on you; see text
